threads.Author: rcliao
threads.Text:
[Q] Phase 3 and 4 seems like we can look into something more ... about multi-agent collaboration after.

Currently, we have:
1. agent research, and write the initial plan
2. human review and comment
3. agent re-review, edit and loop with step 2 until plan is signed off
4. agent gets to implement

On step 4, I think there is industry trend to split into multi agents and more always on agents.

I'm wondering if there is a new sort of workflow that we may not think about in terms of living document once we get to implement to coordinate status across implementation and bring back findings.
